sections.heading: 0.1.0-alpha.2
paragraphs: The first published candidate for testing the site download path. It is neither a stable release nor completed alpha acceptance.

sections.heading: Checks that the bytes match. It does not replace a publisher’s digital signature.
Download test
paragraphs: This build has no automatic updates.

sections.heading: Added
paragraphs: A Windows x86_64 first-install installer with UAC and a choice of program folder.
Safe preview and export of a diagnostic report to a separate JSON file.
Public installer and checksum downloads without a GitHub account.

sections.heading: Known limitations
paragraphs: No digital signature. Do not bypass SmartScreen warnings or other Windows protections.
First installation only: an existing installation or nonempty program folder is rejected. Reinstallation, repair, and automatic updates are not ready.
Installation and initial setup of this exact candidate have not yet been tested on a clean PC. The minimum supported Windows version is still being determined.
Build metadata honestly reports source_dirty: true due to earlier QA helpers not included in the package. This does not satisfy the clean-release-source requirement.
